rhino.name: River's Iron Wall
rhino.line: Hold the fords, brothers. Let the river run red with their blood, not ours. Stand firm until the mist clears.

tiger.name: General of House TIGER
tiger.line: Stand firm, brothers! Hold the fords, protect our camp, and let no enemy standard pass our lines!

kite.name: Kite General, Skyward Bound
kite.line: Ride the wind, hold the fords, claim victory!

orchid.name: The Iron Bloom
orchid.line: Roots grip stone—hold the fords until the last watch ends.

rhino.thought: First watch. No intel on enemies, all at camps. My units are fresh at Rhino Camp. I will hold position to secure my base and conserve strength while fog of war lifts. No reason to risk couriers in open yet.

tiger.thought: No intelligence. My doctrine is to hold. I will move my forces out to secure a ford and establish a strong defensive posture, prioritizing F3 as it is closest to my camp.

orchid.thought: Initial watch. Doctrine is to hold. I will move my forces to hold key positions, starting with the fords closest to my camp, as per doctrine.

rhino.thought: Watch 2. No intel; enemies stationary. Need to secure fords before they do. Send inf-1 to F2 (central, vital) via road. Send cav-1 to scout N-West to F1 axis via hill (misty) to avoid enemy eyes while establishing presence. Hold others at camp.

tiger.thought: No immediate threats or intelligence. My doctrine is to hold. I will move my cavalry to screen and scout nearby areas, while keeping my infantry and archers near Tiger Camp for defense.

orchid.thought: My doctrine is to hold. I will position my forces to secure key fords while maintaining a strong presence at my camp, anticipating enemy movement. No immediate threats are reported.

rhino.thought: Watch 3 of 30. All units at camp, no enemy contact. Need to secure fords before Kite or Tiger. F2 is central; F1 is close to my camp via n-west. Moving inf-2 to F1 and arch-1 to F2 to establish a defensive line on the north bank.

tiger.thought: Holding doctrine. Tiger forces are at TIGER CAMP/S-EAST. I need to secure F3 and F2 if possible, or hold key positions. Since no enemy is seen, I will reinforce my positions and start probing.

orchid.thought: I must consolidate and project towards the fords, adhering to my 'hold' doctrine. My units are currently in the Orchid Camp area. I will move infantry/archers to F1 and F2 to secure them, while cavalry/elephants screen/support.

rhino.thought: No enemy contact in 4 watches. All units at camp. Need to secure fords to win. Inf-2, Arch-1, Ele-1 are fresh (0w). Inf-1 and Cav-1 are 2w stale. I will move fresh units to F1 (West Ford) to establish a foothold. Cav-1 will scout N-West to verify enemy movement.

kite.thought: All five Kite squads are at KITE CAMP (0w old). No enemy sightings yet. Need to secure two fords before watch 30. F3 is closest via n-east; F2 via north-village->n-mid. Sending cavalry to scout F3, infantry to hold F3 and F2.

orchid.thought: Doctrine is 'hold'. I need to reinforce F1 and maintain presence around my camp. Cav and Ele are at camp, inf is at S-West. I will move inf to F1 to hold it, using a cipher to be cautious.

tiger.thought: It's watch 4. My doctrine is to hold. I have units near my camp (tiger-camp) and one foot unit at s-east. I should consolidate and start securing the eastern ford (F3) or supporting my existing presence there. I'll use my elephants to secure the area near my main force.

rhino.thought: Orchid holds F1 (1w ago). I hold no fords. My inf is at camp. To win, I must secure 2 fords. I will send Inf-1 to F2 (neutral) and Inf-2 to F1 to contest Orchid. Cav-1 screens n-west to protect the approach. Arch and Ele hold camp.

kite.thought: All squads at KITE CAMP (1w old). No enemy intel. Need to secure fords early. F3 via n-east is closest; F2 via north-village->n-mid; F1 farther west. Moving infantry toward F3 and F2, archers to support, cavalry to screen.

tiger.thought: Tiger is on the defensive, holding S-East. I need to secure F3 and potentially expand influence. I will move my infantry to hold F3 and use archers to cover the approach.

orchid.thought: My doctrine is to hold. I have troops near F1 and S-Mid. Rhino cavalry is at N-West, near F1. I should reinforce my positions and probe enemy movement.

rhino.thought: My scouts are 2 watches old, but I know Orchid inf held F1. I must secure the north bank to prevent crossing. I will send infantry to F1 to contest/hold, and archers to F2 to deny access. The elephants and second infantry hold camp to secure the rear and catch any riders.

orchid.thought: I must consolidate my forces to secure the fords. My infantry is positioned at F1 and S-mid. I will move my archers and cavalry to reinforce the fords and put pressure on the enemy presence near F1.

tiger.thought: No intel, doctrine is hold. I will hold my positions and prepare to move towards the fords to secure them, as per my doctrine.

rhino.thought: F2 is contested: my inf-1 is at N-Mid (1w ago) vs Orchid inf at F2 (1w ago). F1 is held by my inf-2 but threatened by Orchid inf/arch at F1 (1w ago). Must reinforce F2 immediately to secure the middle ford. Hold F1 to maintain presence.

tiger.thought: I must secure F3 (East Ford) to maintain pressure. My forces are positioned to support this. I will move my infantry and cavalry to F3 to contest the Kite cavalry there. The doctrine is to hold.

orchid.thought: We hold a position at F1 and S-mid (via inf-2). Rhino has units at F1 and N-west. I need to reinforce F1 and secure F2/F3 to meet the win condition. I'll move inf-1 to reinforce F1 and move inf-2 towards F2.

rhino.thought: Reports are 2w old. F1 and F2 are contested by Orchid. F3 is unseen, likely free. My archers at Nong Village can screen F2. Cavalry at N-Bank West is near F3. I will hold F1, screen F2, and scout F3 to secure two fords.

tiger.thought: My forces are positioned near F3. Kite has a cavalry unit at F3 (2w ago). I should reinforce F3 with my infantry/cavalry to secure it, adhering to the 'hold' doctrine. I will use a smoke to advance my main forces.

orchid.thought: My doctrine is to hold. I have units at F1 and F2. Rhino is pressing at F1 and N-mid. I will reinforce F1 and try to keep my position strong, relying on my units' current locations.

rhino.thought: Orchid holds F1 and F2 (1w, 3w). My inf-1 is at n-mid (3w), likely contested by Orchid inf at F2. Inf-2, Arch, Cav are at n-west (1w). I must secure F1 to counter Orchid's grip. Cav can move n-west to F1. Arch holds n-west for defense. Inf-1 holds n-mid to contest F2.

orchid.thought: My infantry and archers are at F1. Rhino has forces near F1 and F2 (3w ago). I need to consolidate and press my advantage at F1 before Rhino reinforces. I will move my cavalry to support F1 and keep archers positioned to shoot.

tiger.thought: My forces are positioned at F3 and s-east. I need to secure more fords or strike at enemy positions. Kite is near F3/N-east. I will reinforce F3 and probe N-east.

rhino.thought: F1 is contested by Orchid (inf/arch/cav, 2w ago). F2 held by my Inf-1 (4w ago, risky). Inf-2 is fresh at Camp. I must secure F1 to win. Move Inf-2 to F1 to break the enemy cluster. Hold F2. Arch/Cav hold N-West to support or intercept.

tiger.thought: It is Watch 10. My forces are established at F3 and S-East. The Kite presence at N-East is a threat. I should reinforce F3 and scout the northern approaches to secure F3.

orchid.thought: Rhino is strong around F1/F2. My forces are at F1/F2. I should reinforce F2 with my elephants to break Rhino's potential push there, while keeping F1 held. I'll move my archers/cav to support the center.

rhino.thought: F1, F2, F3 all hold Orchid units (1w old). I must break F1 to win. My cavalry and archers are already at N-West/N-Mid. Move Inf-1 to F1 to support. Hold Camp to protect Elephants. Intercepting the Orchid letter confirms they are reinforcing the West/Mid fords.

orchid.thought: Rhino has significant presence around F1 and F2. My infantry at F1 is strong (100) and supported by archers/cavalry. I should consolidate and push towards F2 to secure two fords. Moving inf-2 to F2 is priority.

tiger.thought: It's Watch 11. I hold a strong presence at F3 (East Ford) with infantry and archers. Kite is near F3. I should solidify my hold and pressure them. Tiger cav is positioned to contest the north bank.

rhino.thought: Orchid holds F1 & F2 (2w ago). I hold F3 via inf-1/cav-1. Need 2 fords to win. F2 is weak (42 inf). Move inf-2 to F2 to contest. Keep F3. Arch/Ele hold camp.

orchid.thought: Rhino is pressuring F1 and F2. My doctrine is to hold. I need to reinforce my positions at F1 and F2 while keeping an eye on the Rhino movements. The rhino forces are spread thin but strong. I will use my existing forces to hold.

tiger.thought: My forces are clustered around F3 (SE). The enemy Kite is at NBE (near F3). I should reinforce F3 and secure the other fords. My doctrine is to hold.

orchid.thought: Rhino is probing F1 and F2. My doctrine is to hold. I need to reinforce F1 and F2 positions. Rhino's forces are scattered but strong, especially their cavalry. I will move my infantry and cavalry to secure the fords.

tiger.thought: My forces are strong at F3 (East Ford) and S-East. Rhino/Kite are near F3. I will consolidate and push towards F2 to secure more fords.

rhino.thought: F1 and F2 are held by Orchid (reports 4w/2w old). My forces are largely at camp or stale. Kite/Tiger status unknown. I must probe. Sending cavalry to N-West to catch riders or spot Kite movements near N-Village/Village. Holding others to preserve strength for counter-attack if F1

tiger.thought: My forces are at F3 (East Ford) and S-East. Rhino is at N-East, threatening F3. I should reinforce F3 and secure my current position, adhering to the 'hold' doctrine.

orchid.thought: Rhino is massing near F1 and F2. Orchid must consolidate and strike. Holding current positions seems best given doctrine, but I need to reinforce F1 or attack a weak point.

rhino.thought: My cavalry is 6w old, likely lost or captured. I have strong infantry and elephants at camp. Orchid holds F1 (95 strength) and F2 (42 strength, 6w old). I must secure F2 to counter their hold. I will move Second Foot to F2 and screen with Bowmen to protect the crossing.

orchid.thought: Rhino has several units near my fords/camp. Orchid inf-1 is at F1 (2w ago). I should reinforce F1 with infantry to secure it, and move archers to cover key approaches like F2/F3 area. Rhino cav is a major threat.

tiger.thought: My infantry and archers are at F3 (EAST FORD). I need to solidify this position and probe enemy movements. The rhino cavalry is reported near my F3, so holding F3 is crucial. I will reinforce my F3 position.

rhino.thought: Fog is thick. Orchid holds F1 (West Ford) with heavy forces (95 inf, 18 arch). Kite has massed at Nong Village (100 inf, 92 arch), threatening our archers and camp. I must hold the center and west. I will reinforce Nong Village with inf-2 and move inf-1 to N-West to support F1 an

orchid.thought: Rhino is active near F1 and F2, threatening our position. My doctrine is to hold. I need to reinforce F1 and maintain presence near key points.

rhino.thought: Kite is massing at Nong Village (1w), threatening my F2 and Cav. My Inf-1 is at N-West (1w) which is adjacent to F1. Orchid is weak at F1 (3w old). I must secure F1 and F2. Sending Inf-1 to hold F1. Sending Inf-2/Arch to hold F2. Cav screens N-West to intercept Kite movement.

tiger.thought: My forces are strong at F3 (East Ford). Rhino is near N-East/F3, Kite is also near N-East/F3. I should solidify control and perhaps probe the northern flank.

orchid.thought: Rhino is active around F1/N-West. My infantry/cav at F1/S-West need to consolidate or push. Rhino archers are near N-West (11w ago). I should reinforce F1 and put pressure on rhino's western flank.

rhino.thought: F2 is empty (last orchid movement 12w ago). F1 is contested by stale orchid reports (4w) vs my inf (2w). F3 is unobserved. My cavalry is fresh at camp. I will secure the middle ford to guarantee one hold, and deploy cavalry to screen the east ford to prevent kite/orchid seizure.

orchid.thought: Orchid holds F1 (inf/cav) and F2 (ele). Rhino has units at F1/F2/N-West. I should reinforce F1 and F2, and keep archers near camp to contest enemy movement.

tiger.thought: Tiger has strong forces at F3 (East Ford). Rhino/Kite presence is vague but noted near N-East/N-West. I will reinforce F3 to secure it and scout the approaches.

rhino.thought: Fog is thick (3w+). Reports show Kite at Nong Village and Orchid at West Ford. My forces are split. I must consolidate to hold central ground. Moving Inf-1 to N-Mid secures F2 and links with Inf-2/Arch. Keeping Cav at Camp is risky but moving it blindly into mist or enemy lines i

tiger.thought: Last watch, need to secure fords or take camps. Tiger has strong presence at F3 (East Ford). Rhino/Kite are near NBE. I should reinforce F3 or push towards F2/F1, but my units are clustered near F3. Holding F3 with current strength seems best given the time pressure.

rhino.thought: F2 is critical. Reports (4w old) show kite and my inf-2/arch-1 stuck at Nong Village, blocking F2 access. Tiger controls F3 (2w). Orchid held F1 (6w). I must move inf-2 to F2 to secure the ford. Elephants are fresh (0w) at camp; keep them ready. Archers can screen North Bank Midd

tiger.thought: It is Watch 24. My forces are concentrated at F3 (East Ford) and S-East. Rhino is near N-East. I should consolidate and prepare to defend F3 or challenge Rhino's position. I'll reinforce F3 with my archers and elephants to secure it.

rhino.thought: F3 is held by Tiger (100 inf, 100 arch, 60 cav) 3w ago. F2 is empty; I can hold it. F1 was held by Orchid 7w ago. My Inf-1 is near F3 but weak vs Tiger; Inf-2 at Nong Village is 5w stale. I will consolidate: send Inf-2 to N-Mid to secure F2, screen Inf-1 at F3, and hold others to

tiger.thought: Watch 25. My forces are concentrated at F3. Rhino is nearby at F3 (1w ago). I must consolidate and push for F1 or F2, or take a camp. The captured rhino letter suggests they know my forces are at F3. I will hold F3 and screen against any attacks.

rhino.thought: Fog is thick. Inf-1 (4w) and Cav-1 (2w) must be at fords. Inf-2/Arch (6w) likely engaged at Nong Village. Elephant is fresh. I must secure F1 (West) and F2 (Mid) to win. F1 is threatened by Orchid Cav (2w). F2 is likely contested or empty. I will move Inf-1 to F2 and Cav-1 to F1

orchid.thought: Rhino has several units near our fords (F1, F2). My doctrine is to hold. I have infantry at F1, and an elephant at S-Mid to support the F2/F1 area. I should consolidate forces and reinforce the holding positions, prioritizing the fords against Rhino's pressure.

tiger.thought: It is Watch 26. I hold the doctrine. Tiger has two strong forces at F3 (East Ford). Rhino has foot there too. I should consolidate and reinforce F3. My cavalry is at TIGER CAMP, ready to move. I will move the elephants to support the infantry at F3, and use the cavalry to screen/

tiger.thought: It's Watch 27. I need to secure F3 (East Ford) or push elsewhere. Rhino is at F3 (3w ago). I have strong forces at F3. I will hold F3 and reinforce the line.

rhino.thought: F1 held by weak inf-1 (1) vs strong orchid (95, 10w). F2/F3 unknown but likely contested. Kite at Nong (8w) is stale. Elephant at camp is useless. Must secure F1 with mass. Move Inf-2 (60) to F1. Move Cav-1 (42) to F1. Hold Inf-1.

orchid.thought: Rhino is pressing F1/F2 area. My infantry/elephants at F1/S-W are vulnerable. I need to reinforce F1 or consolidate. Rhino has multiple orders targeting my positions.

tiger.thought: Last watch, need to secure a win. Tiger has strong presence at F3 (E. Ford). Rhino is there too. I will reinforce F3 with infantry and use cavalry to threaten nearby positions, hoping to take a camp standard or hold two fords.

rhino.thought: Last watch. My inf-1 is at camp. Enemies are old (5-19w). We must hold F1 and F2 to win. F1 is adjacent to camp. I will send inf-1 to F1. The rest are too far or stale to move effectively in 1 watch to secure F2 or F3.

orchid.thought: Rhino is pressuring F1 and F2. My inf/ele at W. Ford/S. Bank West are holding F1. I need to reinforce F1 and F2, and maintain pressure on Rhino. I will move my forces to secure F1 and F2.

tiger.thought: Last watch. Tiger has strong presence at F3 (East Ford). Rhino and Kite are far north. Need to secure F1/F2 or capture a camp. My troops are strong at F3. I will consolidate and push towards the center/west.

rhino.thought: Final watch. F2 and F3 are key to winning. F2 must be held immediately as our only nearby force. F3 is likely contested by Tiger (seen 8w ago). Orchid at F1 is irrelevant to the 2-ford win condition. Send Inf-2 to F2 now. Send Cav-1 to F3 to contest/hold. Inf-1 holds camp.

orchid.thought: Last watch. I must secure two fords or take a standard. Rhino has units at F1 and F2. Orchid inf-1/ele-1 at F1, orchid-inf-2/arch-1 at S-W. I will reinforce F1 and push towards F2 to maximize chances.
